description: Write a new note into the vault's capture folder with graph-ready frontmatter. Use for plans, decisions, ideas, meeting notes, or session logs the owner wants to keep. Not for one-line facts (use brain_remember). The reply lists existing notes the body names without linking.

body.description: Markdown body. Link related notes inside the sentence that says how they relate, e.g. 'The restore steps are in [[Restore the ledger database]]'; a bare list of links carries little weight.

project.description: Project hub name this belongs to, e.g. 'Website Redesign'

title.description: Specific noun phrase, not a filename

name: brain_capture
title: Save a durable note
